notes.title: Cross The Road Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b][h1]🚦 CROSS THE ROAD UPDATE 🚦[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279941/8223ef14f35ff4451c3e628c903ce7f4d1d5c3ba.png[/img]


[h3][b]🎮 Gameplay & Controls[/b][/h3]
• New Game Mode: "Cross The Road" – (2-4 players, local & online) 🚗➡️ Dodge traffic and cross as many roads as possible! The player who travels the farthest wins!
• Added bots to Goal Rush – local play no longer requires at least two players
• Added a bot management menu for Goal Rush and Floor Fall
• Fixed an issue where pausing the game in Floor Fall (local play) didn’t pause the survival time bonus
• Fixed a bug where using a double jump caused players to bounce off the ceiling (Floor Fall)
• Fixed a bug where some players were teleported one floor lower at the start of a game (Floor Fall)
• Improved spectating after a game ends or falling into the void – eliminated players are now skipped when switching between players

[b][h3]🖥️ UI & Accessibility[/h3][/b]
• Added missing translations in various parts of the game
• Added messages indicating when waiting for players to join a lobby and the lobby player limit
• Players will no longer see their own nickname during online matches
• Fixed an issue where the PLAY button would sometimes not appear after leaving the settings menu in a lobby
• Fixed an issue where the PLAY button was missing in created lobbies
• Improved UI display and fixed various UI-related bugs

[b][h3]🔊 Audio & Sound[/h3][/b]
• Reduced default music volume
• Added new soundtracks 🎶
• Removed walking sounds for bots

[b][h3]⚙️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][/b]
• Removed Sumo mode from online play
• Added missing object collisions (Bouncy Race)
• Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would not hide after using an emoji
• Shortened ban durations for leaving online matches
• Improved ban-related messages for creating and joining lobbies
• Fixed an issue preventing players from joining a lobby after receiving a ban
• Fixed an issue where hosts couldn’t start a game in certain situations
• Added 70+ new lobby name options

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3][b]🎮 Gameplay & Controls[/b][/h3]
• Added the ability to play Floor Fall solo – no longer requires more than one player for local play, as AI bots will now fill empty spots
• Changed the default key for adding players from TAB to E (keyboard & mouse)

[h3][b]🖥️ UI & Accessibility[/b][/h3]
• Added a Welcome Screen for new and returning players who haven’t seen it yet
• Added a message informing players when no available lobbies are found

[h3][b]⚙️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3]
• Fixed various issues in Floor Fall mode

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]🎮 Gameplay & Controls[/b][/h3]
• Improved camera smoothness when spectating other players (Bouncy Race, Floor Fall)
• Adjusted Sumo platform shrink timer – it now starts shrinking faster
• Added an invisible ceiling in Sumo mode to prevent unintended jumps
• Improved knockback mechanics for smoother interactions
• Players can now freely control the camera in Bouncy Race and Floor Fall

[b][h3]🖥️ UI & Accessibility[/h3][/b]
• Fixed inconsistent mouse sensitivity across different game modes
• Fixed an issue where input prompts were incorrect when joining a lobby
• Improved emoji selection on gamepads – switched input from left stick to right stick
• Enhanced emoji selection responsiveness when using a controller
• Fixed a bug where button hover animations (Play Again, Leave Game, etc.) didn’t play properly

[b][h3]🎮 Controller Support[/h3][/b]
• Added an in-game notification when a controller gets disconnected
• When launching the game for the first time, it will now automatically retrieve the player’s Steam nickname (up to 12 characters) and suggest it as a default option

[b][h3]⚙️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][/b]
• Fixed an issue where the skybox in Bouncy Race wouldn’t change after clicking “Play Again”
• Fixed an issue where players couldn’t exit the game properly in Goal Rush and Floor Fall
• Fixed various issues in Floor Fall mode, including “Play Again” functionality, spectating, and cursor visibility
• Fixed a bug where total distance traveled wasn’t correctly recorded in player statistics
• Fixed a bug that prevented random nickname generation from the database on first launch
• Improved private lobbies: when the host leaves a game mode, all players will be properly transferred back to the lobby instead of getting disconnected

notes.title: Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
[b][h3]🎮 Controller Support[/h3][/b]
• Added full controller support
• Added the ability to generate a random nickname on first game launch
• Added a notification when a controller gets disconnected
• Fixed a bug where a player was not removed from the team after disconnecting the controller (Goal Rush)

[b][h3]🛒 Store & Microtransactions[/h3][/b]
• Reduced pack prices in the store
• Added purchase confirmation messages for store packs
• Improved microtransaction handling

[h3][b]🖱️ UI & Accessibility[/b][/h3]
• Improved cursor visibility toggling
• Reduced the size of the emoji wheel

[b][h3]⚙️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][/b]
• Fixed a bug causing resolution/window mode changes when returning to the lobby, creating a lobby, or leaving a lobby
• Fixed an issue that allowed infinite double jumping
